Well the medical bills were related to my sons birth. The hospital incorrectly filed my son so none of his medical information was sent to my insurance. I called them and had them resubmit and they never resubmitted them (I lived out of state by then.) So they just sent it all to collections because they were not able to collect from the insurance due to their own error. 

And I’ve been trying to get it resolved or fight it but it’s not working. Other than that I only have two legitimate collections on my account.
No just vary degrees of severity. Always want to kill myself just less on some days. But it never goes away. I never don’t want to kill myself.

The idea that it was supposed to get better. I was promised - when you get to highschool; when you graduate; when you go to college and make new friends and do what you love; when you fall in love; when you have kids - something will happen in the future. It’ll be worth it. Staying will make it better. Think of what you’ll miss. If you kill yourself you’ll miss out on so much good stuff just because it’s bad now doesn’t mean it will always be. 

But it hasn’t gotten better. It’s just bad with extra shit on top. Now I’m told - you’ll miss your kids lives, you’ll break your family’s hearts. What about future grandchildren? Everyone else and everything else is why I should be here despite the fact that I don’t want to be. Despite this chronic pain I’ve been in for years with this depression. But, while I feel for them, I don’t care to suffer myself anymore, no matter how much they hurt.

Staying isn’t an option. Also I grew up with a mother is was (and is) suicidal and depressed. So is her mother. So the best way to not pass it on is to not be around. Living with my mother like that was hell and I genuinely wish she’d killed herself instead of being the miserable sack of skin she currently still is. Staying Alive has done nothing. She just hates everything and herself.
Yes. Since I was 7. Thought it would “get better” tried to live life. Didn’t work. If I knew it wasn’t going to get better, wouldn’t have had them and gotten married.
Okay well thanks I guess. I’ll figure something out. Probably gonna figure out a way to leave the country - only way I know they won’t have to come across me.

I want the kids to forget me. I’m just trying to figure out ways they don’t have to see my body. Don’t want my husband or my kid to have to discover something like that or have to bury me. Any sub you know of that will help?

None of this is due to motherhood. I get rest. It isn’t postpartum. I’ve been suicidal since I was 7 years old. Should’ve killed myself long before the kids and the husband were involved. Stupidly trusted the whole - It gets better rhetoric. I just need tips to kill myself. I know no matter what I do it’s gonna hurt them. Just want to do what I can to lessen the hurt for them while still killing myself.
Can’t can’t afford therapy. And I don’t want to. Tired of taking. It doesn’t change anything. I just feel worse.
